subject: Streamlined JSON delivery & streaming enablement for MedCare
messages:
From: Elaine Wu <elaine.wu@medcare.io>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 7 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Streamlined JSON delivery & streaming enablement for MedCare

Hi Sergio —

Thanks again for the demo last week. MedCare is ready to move from pilot to production for two features that rely on streaming responses and deterministic structured outputs: clinical note extraction (streaming tokens + JSON schema) and a small set of automated tool calls for medication reconciliation.

We'd like a short CS handoff + technical sync next week to align on:
- JSON schema mapping for the clinical-extract output (we have current export samples attached)
- How Redwood handles prefix caching and streaming windows (latency targets are critical)
- Auth pattern for function/tool calling from our EHR integration (we need the recommended approach for per-request short-lived creds)

Can your team run through the schema and share a draft runbook and owner list before the call? Prefer Wed 11/10 in the morning Pacific.

Attachments: medcare_sample_payloads.json (application/json)

Best,
Elaine
Director, Integrations
MedCare Systems
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Wu <elaine.wu@medcare.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 7 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Streamlined JSON delivery & streaming enablement for MedCare

Thanks Elaine — this is exactly the right scope. Wed 11/10 09:30 PT works for our team; I sent a calendar hold.

Quick plan from our side:
- Marissa will own the JSON schema mapping and provide a draft mapping document (including edge-case rules for omitted fields).
- Monica will prepare an ops runbook covering cache warm-up, batching, and expected recovery behaviors.
- I'll coordinate the function/tool calling auth design with Connor to ensure the pattern fits your security constraints (short-lived tokens vs. proxying).

I'm attaching our recommended starting schema (redwood_streaming_schema_v0.2.json) — it includes streaming chunk markers and a suggested top-level metadata section. Can you confirm the sample payloads you've attached are representative of all sources (clinic notes, RX history, discharge summaries)? If there are additional variants please drop them in the Drive link in my calendar invite.

Attachments: redwood_streaming_schema_v0.2.json (application/json)

Regards,
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 08:20:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: MedCare kickoff — roles & deliverables (please read before 11/10)

Team —

Forwarding Elaine's note and the sample payloads. Short bullets so we can sync quickly tomorrow:

Marissa — lead on schema mapping:
- Produce a mapping doc to convert MedCare's payloads into our redwood_streaming_schema_v0.2 shape.
- Call out required fields vs. optional, and rules for repeated sections (med lists).
- Deliverable: draft mapping + 1-page diff doc by EoD 11/9.

Monica — ops/runbook:
- Outline warm-up steps, recommended batch sizes for low-latency clinical flows, and KV cache TTL suggestions.
- Define SLOs we can commit to for the phased rollout (canary -> prod).
- Deliverable: runbook draft + rollback checklist by 11/9 close.

Connor — security & tool-calling:
- Review two options: (A) short-lived per-request JWT issued by MedCare Auth -> validated by Redwood; (B) proxy call pattern where MedCare calls a Redwood proxy service to perform tool calls. Map tradeoffs and required infra changes.
- Deliverable: recommendation + list of technical questions for MedCare IT by 11/9.

I'll consolidate and send a final meeting agenda before the call. Keep replies short — we only have a day to prepare.

Thanks,
Sergio
From: Elaine Wu <elaine.wu@medcare.io>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: MedCare IT <it@medcare.io>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 14:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Streamlined JSON delivery & streaming enablement for MedCare

Appreciate the plan and tight timelines. A few clarifications from IT before tomorrow:
- For tool-calling auth, we prefer not to proxy sensitive EHR credentials. Short-lived JWTs with mutual TLS are our likely default but need to validate key rotation timing.
- Can Redwood's streaming schema support partial outputs (i.e., emit field-level confidence scores incrementally)? We need to capture confidence for each extracted entity in the streaming payload.
- SOW: we'd like a one-page statement of work outlining deliverables and milestones; can you share a draft so procurement can review prior to the kickoff?

I'll have our security engineer, Rajesh Kumar (rajesh.kumar@medcare.io), on the call as well.

Best,
Elaine
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Wu <elaine.wu@medcare.io>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 15:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Streamlined JSON delivery & streaming enablement for MedCare — Action plan & artifacts

Hi all — follow-up from our prep and next steps (agenda for 11/10 09:30 PT is attached to the calendar invite).

Deliverables we will share on the call / within 24 hours:
1) JSON mapping doc (marissa_cole) — will include field-level confidence support as an optional per-entity attribute, and an example of an incremental chunk that contains confidence scores.
2) Ops runbook (monica_patel) — warm-up sequence, recommended batch sizes, KV cache TTLs, and canary run checklist.
3) Auth options write-up (connor_obrien) — short-lived JWT + mTLS pattern preferred; will list token lifetime recommendations and rotation cadence needed for compliance.
4) Draft one-page SOW (sow_medcare_streaming_draft.docx) — outlines milestones: mapping sign-off, canary window (2 weeks), production cutover, and success metrics (latency p95 < 450ms for 90% of requests; structured-output fidelity > 95% on core prompt set).

For the streaming schema question: yes, we can emit partial outputs with an `entities` array where each entity includes `confidence` and `final` flags. We'll present an example in the mapping doc.

Action items (owners & due dates):
- Marissa: mapping draft + example payloads (due 11/10 08:00 PT)
- Monica: runbook draft + canary checklist (due 11/10 08:00 PT)
- Connor: auth decision doc + questions for Rajesh (due 11/10 08:00 PT)
- Sergio: consolidate and send SOW to Elaine + procurement (target 11/10 17:00 PT)

Links and artifacts: Drive folder (shared in calendar), SOW draft: https://app.hellosign.com/s/MEDCARE-SOW-2026

Attachments: sow_medcare_streaming_draft.docx, redwood_streaming_schema_v0.2.json, medcare_sample_payloads.json

Looking forward to the call — we'll keep it to 45 minutes and come out with a clear sign-off path.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Product Enablement | Redwood Inference
